No. The rules file marks `is.waiwai.dictation` as permanent because existing Accessibility grants depend on it. A new bundle ID would drop that permission for everyone who has installed a build, and existing installs would also have trouble updating through Sparkle.

For the OpenRamble name at launch, change the display name and keep the bundle ID. Set `CFBundleDisplayName` (and the product name, if you want it) to OpenRamble.

If you still want a new bundle ID, that's a change to the release invariants, and you'd need to make it explicitly. I can't check the project files in this session, so I haven't confirmed where the name is set.
